items.Description:
The magic staff of the Raver is said to have been imbued with part of Eveyil's soul.

Beware lest it hungers for more.

items.Name: Club of Nails
items.Description: This club was torn from the grasp of the Hill Giant King.  Its strike has a fierocity bourne of the dozens of nails that bristle along its lenth.

items.Name: Witty Riposte
items.Description: In combat agility of mind is just as important as strength of arm.  This spindly rapier may not be as fearsome as some, but too often it finds weak chinks in an opponent's defence.

items.Name: Staff of the Necromage
items.Description: This rare staff holds the key power for many inspiring necromancers.  It has been known to be used to summon the dead for armies of the ancient wars.

items.Name: Formian Queen Staff
items.Description: This type of staff is the pinnacle of the artificer's craft, and each one represents the culmination of decades of study by a master spellcaster. With the secrets of their creation all but lost, more such staffs are found in the horde of ancient dragons than the hands of living …

items.Name: Ice Blade Halberd
items.Description: These mighty halberds are used by the Ice Blade Guards.

items.Name: King's Scythe
items.Description: This item was modeled on Baron Gordaire Knightshold's weapon, a ceremonial scythe meant to make him look more rural and less a tyrant. items.Description: Briarspikes look like they could have been plucked from some giant quill-covered beast, but the methods involved are very sophisticated and bear the hallmarks of Menold of Waterdeep. items.Name: Yulik's Jolting Spear
items.Description: This spear was once used by Yulik, the high mage of the Asabi Tribe.  The electical jolt that you get from this weapon is very deadly.

items.Name: Ghoulish Poker
items.Description: These spears are usually carried by Larad's soldiers.  There tips would cause even the healthiest skin to decay.
